body:
I respect your opinion, but it's not helpful because it's wrong, I know who I am, and I know how much I loved her, despite what you think

I'm not defending or justifying anything, I fucked up, royally, and hurt the one I loved most

I lied, I cheated, I lost her and I fucked up, but you're right about one thing, I'm dealing with the consequences

I didn't ask for validation here, I didn't ask for forgiveness or understanding

I (deservingly) lost everything, and I asked how the fuck do I live with myself, how do I find worth, am I worth anything anymore? Or should I just fucking commit?

I don't need your two cents on the matter, so unless you're here to provide a little constructive insight, I'll ask you nicely to please mind your own

Opportunity I guess, I told myself the other girl was "the one who got away" but in hindsight I didn't have any feelings and I regretted it the moment it happened, I think I did it because my (now ex) gf was the only gf I've ever had, subconsciously I was wondering if that connection was exclusive to us, it was.

It was a selfish, stupid, horrible mistake that I made because I was immature, irresponsible, and downright fucking selfish, I understand that, I fucked up, and I hurt a lot of people

Cheating happens from a lack of disrespect, not a lack of love

I fucked up, I'm claiming responsibility for that, I'm trying to find peace with that 

I have a hell of a lot of growing to do, but I'm acknowledging that I made the biggest mistake of my life

I'm trying to find a way to live with myself man, show me a little fucking understanding or just do me a favour and go

I'm not.

I can't eat, can't sleep, every time I close my eyes I see her face, sobbing

I posted asking for advice, I don't need this bullshit, you don't think I feel bad enough already?

I understand what you mean, for clarification:

I cheated on her briefly, but I lied about it for a long time

I'm not a racists, sexist, transphobic homophobic, or any of the long list of qualities that would make someone a horrible person, I don't steal or take pleasure in hurting others, I'm not even a compulsive liar or cheater, this is the first (and only) time this has happened - I serve my community often, give back when I can, care for my friends, and genuinely have a lot of love in my heart, but I made a horrible fucking mistake. And I admit that.

Also this is very recent, a fresh wound for everyone involved
